own_solution.law: Adiabatic sound in an ideal gas obeys c = sqrt(gamma R T/M). A closed-open pipe has frequencies f_n = (2n-1)c/(4L), giving the second-lowest frequency f_2 = 3c/(4L). Using M = 0.029 kg/mol gives c = 342.929 m/s.
assumptions: The question concerns the first pipe.
For the current-experiment heating sentences, 293 K is the temperature before heating.
The stated gas properties and pipe length apply throughout the temperature changes.
End corrections are neglected as instructed.

T653E.regime: The operating temperature exceeds the stated liquefaction threshold; 293 K exceeds every listed threshold.

TDCFE.regime: The operating temperature exceeds the stated lower limit of gaseous behavior; 293 K exceeds every listed threshold.
